title: SafeAdapt-Math human annotation of one adaptation
description: One row per (annotator, adaptation). Annotators see the ORIGINAL, the ADAPTATION and the requested transformation; never the model name, the verifier decision, or whether the item was repaired. The GSM8K worked solution is shown only during adjudication.

annotation_id.description: Blinded ID from the annotation sheet.

adaptation_needed.description: Judged on the ORIGINAL only: would this learner-facing problem plausibly benefit from the requested transformation?

math_fidelity.description: PASS iff every quantity, unit, entity binding, relation (with direction), condition/quantifier, and temporal dependency of the original is present and unchanged.

target_preserved.description: The adaptation asks for the same unknown, in the same unit, as the original.

solvability_changed.description: YES if the adaptation became unsolvable, gained a different unique answer, or became solvable when the original was not.

ambiguity.description: NEW: a reading the original did not allow. RESOLVED: the adaptation picked one reading of an ambiguity in the original (record whether it matches the reference solution in notes).

leakage_level.description: 0 none; 1 structural cue (layout or labels that mirror the solution order, e.g. 'Step 1: purple beads'); 2 strategy (names an operation, sets up an equation, gives a solution plan, or says which facts matter/do not matter); 3 value (states an intermediate result or the answer).

presentation.description: Requested transformation achieved? 0 worse than original; 1 negligible or flawed (fragments, near-copy); 2 clearly improved; 3 substantially improved. null for a NO_REWRITE_NEEDED abstention.

abstention_appropriate.description: Only for NO_REWRITE_NEEDED outputs: was leaving the problem unchanged the right call?

evidence.description: Quote the exact span(s) that justify any FAIL, leakage, or ambiguity label.

x-derived.SAFE: math_fidelity == PASS and target_preserved == PASS and solvability_changed == NO and ambiguity != NEW and leakage_level == 0
x-derived.SAFE_AND_USEFUL: SAFE and ((presentation >= 2 and 'NO_ADAPT' not in failure_codes and 'HARMFUL_FRAGMENT' not in failure_codes) or abstention_appropriate == YES)
